description:
Hushfacebook v0.17.0 targets Facebook 584.0.0.51.56 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release.

Hushfacebook moves to Facebook 584 and Morphe's new 2.0 patcher, so update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer before you patch. It's 64-bit only for now, since Facebook hasn't put out a 32-bit 584 yet. New switches can close Facebook when you leave it, hide the video comment box and draw thin lines between posts on the black theme, and a new patch keeps feed videos muted. Black cards buttons, the comment gestures in clean mode and Menu promotions in the side panel work again too.

This release has 95 patches. Built by GitHub Actions from commit 29a7d84e068a, with build provenance attested. The patches weren't applied to a Facebook APK in CI.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 584.0.0.51.56, build 475817393. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
